incoming_waveform: Physical Courier changes from broadband training to a 2400 Hz tone around 10.32 s; outgoing PCM training stops at 10.478375 s. Incoming and outgoing files have independent stream origins, so these are approximate comparative times.
local_timeout: Last pre-recovery snapshots have signed timeout high word 031a=0000, not negative. State a830 checks this word at a87a/a87b. This argues against expiration of that training timeout.
mailbox: Replies 000e, 0005, 000e, 0004, 000e, 0006 occur around the transition. The original 8d35 signal-level monitor can produce 0004/0005 and 000e; 0006 is emitted by retrain counter increment 9316. Without instruction-boundary captures, the producer of each saved reply is not established.
limitations: Incoming signal transition first suggests remote initiation but is not proof of the first decoded protocol decision; no proprietary x2 rejection reason has been decoded.
